title: DWT Register Explorer
description: Three 32-bit registers drawn as clickable bit grids, where setting TRCENA then CYCCNTENA starts a live simulated cycle counter.
creator: Real-Time DSP on a $5 Microcontroller
author: Dan McCreary
subject: Digital Signal Processing
Benchmarking
Computer Architecture

learningObjectives: Explain how TRCENA and CYCCNTENA gate the cycle counter
Interpret a 32-bit register as individually addressable bits
Explain why the counter holds rather than resets when disabled

controls.label: DWT.CTRL bit 0 (CYCCNTENA)
controls.purpose: Start or freeze the cycle counter

controls.label: Reset to power-on state
controls.purpose: Clear both bits and the counter

equations: CYCCNT advances only while TRCENA AND CYCCNTENA
assumptions: Counter rate slowed far below 150 MHz so individual bits are readable
Counter holds its value when disabled, matching the real register
limitations: Only the two functional bits are modeled; the other DEMCR and DWT.CTRL fields are shown greyed out

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Progressive enable with staged status feedback
keyQuestions: What happens if you set CYCCNTENA before TRCENA?
Does disabling the counter reset it?
commonMisconceptions: That one enable bit is enough
That disabling the counter clears it
assessmentOpportunities: Diagnose a benchmark reporting 0 cycles for every operation
